answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Work waits on the harbor until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the mirror of the next round. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the cedar of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, converted to a slow vesting stream, rewards vest against future work.
